meta_description:
994 likes, 0 comments - nivedithg on September 20, 2026: "Came for the beach. Ended up planning the day around food. 🤤🌊

A little food trail through InterContinental Chennai Mahabalipuram—beachside bites at KoKoMMo, a leisurely meal at The Melting Pot, and an evening at Gatsby Lounge. 🍽️✨

The kind of ECR outing where “let’s head back after lunch” somehow becomes “shall we stay for dinner?” 😉

Save this for your next coastal escape and send it to the person who’s always ready to order one more dish! 👀

📍InterContinental Chennai Mahabalipuram, ECR

#InterContinentalChennai #ChennaiFoodies #ECR #Mahabalipuram #macrotraveller".
